Definition: a primary verb; to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from G4154, which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of G109, which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively):--wax cold.
BiblicalUsage: Psucho means to breathe gently, to grow cool, to wax cold. It appears once, in Jesus' warning about the last days: because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe cold love is the last days' disease, and it spreads the way iniquity spreads: a little at a time, until the fire is only embers.
